correctness.rationale: Verified Lemma, decomposition and family analytically and by re-running check_norms.py (all checks passed). R commutes with H0, exp(-itH0) and B=cos on S1; applying R to mild equation (1) plus uniqueness for bounded B and u in L1 preserves evenness for all T and all L_inf controls. L2 even/odd orthogonality gives dist(f,E)=||odd part||. Family psi_{f,eps}=(phi0+eps eta)/N with eta=pi^-1/2 sin is normalized, smooth, H3-distance <=4eps (weights (1+k^2)^3, modes 0,+-1) yet odd-part L2 norm eps/N>0, hence outside E and unreachable. This refutes STLC at every T; cost bound irrelevant. Well-posedness/unitarity invocation via Dyson/Kato for bounded perturbation is standard and sufficient. No gap found; TARGET disproof complete as conserved-quantity obstruction explicitly invited by topic.

originality.rationale: REVISED AFTER TERMINAL CHECK: decisive prior found. Boscain-Caponigro-Chambrion-Sigalotti arXiv:1101.4313v4 (verified in full) studies the same S1 system i psi_t=(-d^2+u1 cos+u2 sin)psi and explicitly records that fixing one control to zero leaves a single-cos system that is not controllable by parity: cos does not couple odd with even wave functions. Section 8 formalizes H=H^alpha_e(+)H^alpha_o with cos/sin bases and Lemma 8.1 preserving even/odd L2 norms under the restricted single-direction control, i.e. the same even-subspace invariant from the constant ground state. That globally (approximately) non-controllable parity obstruction substantively implies the submitted H3-local STLC failure; the normalized sine family psi_{f,eps} at H3-distance O(eps) with odd-part eps/sqrt(1+eps^2)>0 is then a routine corollary/repackaging of the known stronger fact, not a new boundary. Originality therefore FAILS.

broader_coverage.evidence: Ball-Marsden-Slemrod (Ball-Marsden-Slemrod 1982; Boussaid-Caponigro-Chambrion extension; Turinici adaptation) says L1/L2 reachable set is meagre / countable union of compacts. Beauchard/Beauchard-Laurent positive local-exact results in higher Sobolev spheres coexist with it because an H^s-neighbourhood is not L2-open. Quadratic-drift papers (Beauchard-Morancey, Bournissou, Gherdaoui) deny STLC under H^{2n-3}/W^{-1,inf} smallness via coercive H^{-n} drift for interval Dirichlet models with degenerate mu. Simultaneous-control census (Morancey 2014) concerns N>=2 coupled interval equations.
broader_coverage.reasoning: None of these broader theorems exhaustively covers or implies the submitted circle-cos parity claim. BMS meagreness does not imply failure of an H3-ball exact reachability and is compatible with STLC; drift obstructions use a different mechanism, geometry and regularity class; the N-particle census does not contain the single-equation circle model as a special case. Hence broader-coverage does not subsume the headline.
broader_coverage.search: Searched dominance query: Beauchard Morancey Ball Marsden Slemrod bilinear Schrodinger obstructions, census, classification and stronger theorems that could cover circle STLC as special case.

claim_vs_prior_implication.evidence: Prior conclusions: (i) interval models are locally controllable under nondegeneracy <mu phi1,phij> lower bounds; (ii) under vanishing <mu phi1,phiK>=0 plus AK^p conditions there is H^{-n} quadratic drift denying regular-STLC; (iii) BMS reachable set is meagre. None states that evenness is conserved for S1 cos control, that every H3-ball around phi0 contains unreachable normalized states, or that reachability from phi0 stays in E at every T for every bounded control.

The parity disproof is therefore not a recomputation, certificate, corollary or repackaging of a known stronger fact.
